title: Standing in line with hundreds of other people in a massive building
content: The other night, I had a dream I was standing in line with hundreds of other people. The building was very modern, mostly beige & white. It had many levels & lots of stairs. I think we were walking downstairs towards the basement or lower levels. You could see everyone on the other side of the building, because the center of the building was cut out, so-to-speak. No one was angry or upset; we were all calm, & in good spirits. I spoke with one or two others in line. We did not know why we were standing there in line...it felt like we were programmed - if that makes sense - to peacefully walk & stand & follow the person in front of us. And again, absolutely no idea what we were walking towards. Anyone else have something similar?
